caption: The drawing depicts two nearly identical female angelic figures, both shown standing and facing forward, positioned side by side against a plain, light beige background. Each figure has long, wavy brown hair, with light tan skin, prominent bare chests, and is clad from the waist down in draped blue robes with folds shaded in grayish-blue and white for dimensional effect. Both figures possess wings that are visible from behind their shoulders and carry a large, curved horn in their right hand, resting it on their right shoulder; the horns are brown with darker shading to emphasize their contours. In their left hand, each figure holds a white sheet or scroll with small, evenly spaced black dots arranged in rows. Their feet are bare, standing on brown platforms that resemble rocky surfaces. The drawing is rendered with consistent lighting and a muted color palette emphasizing earthy tones.
title: Two Angels
